extracted.description: The analysis is based on historical yearly mean sunspot numbers covering the full 1960–2020 window at annual granularity.
Solar activity level is quantified by the yearly mean sunspot number, and the approximate solar activity cycle period is derived from the spacing of detected extremes.
The five years of maximum activity are identified as local peaks of the yearly mean sunspot series within 1960–2020, applying a prominence of 20 and a distance of 5.
The five years of minimum activity are identified as local troughs of the yearly mean sunspot series within 1960–2020 under the same prominence of 20 and distance of 5 rules.
All detected extreme years and the derived cycle period must be mutually consistent and confined to the 1960–2020 window.

stored.description: The analysis is based on historical yearly mean sunspot numbers covering the full 1960–2020 window at annual granularity.
acceptanceCriteria: The analyzed series consists of yearly mean sunspot number values with one value per year.
Year coverage spans 1960 through 2020 inclusive (61 yearly observations), and any gap is explicitly evidenced rather than silently interpolated.
No years outside 1960–2020 contribute to extreme detection, ranking, or the derived cycle period.

assertions.description: 年度序列完整性：分析所用序列必须为按年粒度的太阳黑子年平均值，1960–2020（含端点）每年一个值，共 61 个年度观测；任何缺失年份必须以显式证据说明，不得静默插值。物理 schema（tables=[]，datasourceRevision=2，fallbackReason=DATALINK_UNAVAILABLE）未提供任何可绑定的表或字段，无法建立 SQL 层验证，需人工核对数据源。
时间窗口约束：1960–2020 之外的任何年份不得参与极值检测、排序或周期推导。由于 schema 中不存在太阳黑子相关物理表与年份字段，该口径仅能作为人工验证项。

stored.description: Solar activity level is quantified by the yearly mean sunspot number, and the approximate solar activity cycle period is derived from the spacing of detected extremes.
acceptanceCriteria: Extremes are ranked solely by yearly mean sunspot number; higher value means greater activity for maxima and lower value means lower activity for minima.
The approximate cycle period is expressed in years and equals the average interval between successive detected maxima (or equivalently successive detected minima) within 1960–2020.
The reported period is derivable from the identified extreme years and reported within a rounding tolerance consistent with whole-year spacing.

assertions.description: 活动水平度量与排序口径：活动水平唯一由太阳黑子年平均值量化；极大值按数值从高到低、极小值按数值从低到高排序，不得引入其他度量替代。schema 无对应数值字段可绑定，需人工验证。
周期推导口径：近似活动周期以年为单位，等于 1960–2020 内相邻被检测极大值年份间隔的平均值（或等价地相邻极小值年份间隔的平均值）；报告值须可由被识别的极值年份推导，并符合整年间隔的舍入容差。需人工复核推导过程。

stored.description: The five years of maximum activity are identified as local peaks of the yearly mean sunspot series within 1960–2020, applying a prominence of 20 and a distance of 5.
acceptanceCriteria: Each reported maximum year is a local peak whose prominence is at least 20 sunspot-number units.
All reported maxima are mutually separated by at least 5 years, reflecting the distance parameter of 5.

Exactly five maximum years are reported, ranked by yearly mean sunspot number from highest to lowest; if fewer than five peaks qualify, the shortfall is explicitly evidenced instead of filled with non-qualifying years.

assertions.description: 极大值检测参数约束：每个报告的极大年份必须是太阳黑子年平均值序列的局部峰值，其 prominence 至少为 20 个太阳黑子数单位；任意两个被报告的极大年份相互间隔至少 5 年（对应 distance=5）。schema 未提供序列表与字段，参数适用性需人工验证。
数量与排序约束：恰好报告 5 个极大年份，并按太阳黑子年平均值从高到低排序；若合格峰值不足 5 个，必须显式给出不足的证据，不得用不合格年份填充。需人工核对报告的极大值列表。

stored.description: The five years of minimum activity are identified as local troughs of the yearly mean sunspot series within 1960–2020 under the same prominence of 20 and distance of 5 rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Each reported minimum year is a local trough whose prominence is at least 20 sunspot-number units.
All reported minima are mutually separated by at least 5 years, reflecting the distance parameter of 5.

Exactly five minimum years are reported, ranked by yearly mean sunspot number from lowest to highest; if fewer than five troughs qualify, the shortfall is explicitly evidenced instead of filled with non-qualifying years.

assertions.description: 极小值检测参数约束：每个报告的极小年份必须是太阳黑子年平均值序列的局部谷值，其 prominence 至少为 20 个太阳黑子数单位；任意两个被报告的极小年份相互间隔至少 5 年（对应 distance=5）。schema 未提供序列表与字段，参数适用性需人工验证。
数量与排序约束：恰好报告 5 个极小年份，并按太阳黑子年平均值从低到高排序；若合格谷值不足 5 个，必须显式给出不足的证据，不得用不合格年份填充。需人工核对报告的极小值列表。

stored.description: All detected extreme years and the derived cycle period must be mutually consistent and confined to the 1960–2020 window.
acceptanceCriteria: Every year appearing in the maxima or minima lists falls within 1960–2020 inclusive.
No single year is reported simultaneously as a qualifying maximum and qualifying minimum under the identical prominence and distance parameters.
The prominence and distance filtering is applied symmetrically and consistently to both peak and trough detection, and the resulting period agrees with the year differences among reported extremes.

assertions.description: 窗口与互斥一致性：极大值与极小值列表中出现的每个年份均须落在 1960–2020（含端点）内；在相同的 prominence=20 与 distance=5 参数下，不允许任何单个年份同时作为合格极大值和合格极小值被报告。需人工交叉核对两份极值列表。
对称性与周期一致性：prominence=20 与 distance=5 的过滤须对峰值检测与谷值检测对称且一致地施加；推导出的周期须与报告极值年份之间的年份差值相符。schema 未提供可执行 SQL 的物理表，该一致性仅能通过人工复核极值年份集合验证。
